tools.name: compare_hotels
tools.description: The five hotels that Corissia Resorts offers in Crete, side by side: location, season, ages, character and opening periods. API v3, read only.

tools.name: get_hotel_facts
tools.description: Facts about one hotel and its rooms: identity, operation, policies (ages, pets, check-in), location, pools, dining, services, accessibility, terms, rooms. A fact with the answer "unknown, ask the hotel" is not confirmed by the hotel. API v3.

tools.name: get_room_details
tools.description: Details of one room type of a hotel: name, booking limits (maximum adults, children, total) and facts. Room type ids are those of the rooms of the hotel, e.g. harmony-double. API v3.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Prices and offers for an exact stay and guests at one hotel. The answer is always for the requested dates and guests, or an error with a code (e.g. CHECKIN_IN_PAST, HOTEL_NOT_OPERATING, AGE_RESTRICTION, OCCUPANCY_NOT_SUPPORTED). availability_status "available": the room can be booked on the website

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: Restaurants, bars, café, spa, room and beach service of the five hotels of Corissia Resorts: access, opening hours, services with prices, reservation, menu sections. With hotel: the venues its guests may use, each with access_for_hotel (as hotel guest, or as other guest under a condition such as "ad

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: One venue: access, minimum age, opening hours, services with prices, reservation and its menu sections. Hours, prices and access as published on the website (they may change; hours may vary by season). access: hotel_guests, other_guests with their condition, external_guests, min_age with age_note. T

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: The menu, drinks or spa treatments of a venue with the prices of the website (EUR), as published on as_of; prices may change. price null: the website shows no price for that item. lang_served: the language in which the page shows its menu, when it differs from the requested one. API v3.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Open positions (jobs) at the hotels of Corissia Resorts in Crete, as on the career page: title, summary, departments, location (Georgioupolis, Chania), employment type, salary where published, date posted and the page of the position. Newest first. Applications are made only on the page of the posit

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One open position with its full description (tasks, skills, what we offer) and the page to apply on. JOB_NOT_FOUND: the position is not open (any more). Applications are made only on the page of the position (url), with its form, by the candidate; the connector does not apply and receives no persona

tools.name: corissia_offers
tools.description: Hotel offers for a Corissia hotel and date range, API version 2.0, without a guests parameter. The answer may be for a different stay than the requested one: stay.checkin and stay.checkout show the stay it is for. Kept unchanged for the integrations of the first server.
